column3: NASB follows the critical text (“saying”); “opened” is rendered “standing open,” and NASB supplies “the sound of.”
NASB follows the critical text (without “and,” “on the throne”); “was set” is rendered “was standing.”
NASB follows the critical text (“twenty-four thrones”; without “they had”).
“Voices” is rendered “sounds,” and “thunderings” “peals of thunder”; “come” is rendered “proceed.”
NASB follows the critical text (“as it were”); “midst” is rendered “center.”
NASB follows the critical text (“had a face like that of a man”); “living creature” is rendered “creature.”
NASB follows the critical text; it supplies “is” and renders “rest not they have” as “they do not cease.”
NASB follows the critical text (“on the throne”); “thanksgiving” is rendered “thanks.”
